title: Named-root capacity: legacy rows and unbound roots of held or idle items occupy the 64-slot cap indefinitely, and a session cannot release its own root while it is in a turn
outcome: Named-root capacity: legacy rows and unbound roots of held or idle items occupy the 64-slot cap indefinitely, and a session cannot release its own root while it is in a turn
acceptance: A named root with no live claim binding whose item is completed, cancelled, superseded, or held is reclaimed or released without an operator round, by a documented, audited rule that never touches a live claim
Legacy rows with no canonical run association have a supported one-time disposition (for example, a release when the root path no longer exists or the claim is closed), recorded per row

A session can release its own unbound named root through a supported surface (for example an MCP tool or a clear-name call) without the busy-session refusal that the operator route applies; focused tests, the full gate and an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding

completion.summary:
Named-root capacity, landed as dd4ccaf3.
- C1: the automatic reclamation pass also retires a root whose Engram claim is released or completed, or, while no session holds or may hold its binding (including a naming session kept aside at restore), lapsed beyond a 2 h grace or with its naming session gone. A later fence is not closure. The claim journal is retired so compaction drops it.
- C2: a disposition pass in the same flight releases legacy roots (path gone, item completed or cancelled read through the Work host reader, or naming session gone) and claim-refused roots by an audited rule (route automatic). It is bounded at 8 s from the pass start with a 6 s read reserve, and confirms unacknowledged releases on later passes.
- C3: a naming session releases its own unbound root mid-turn via termal_release_named_root / POST /api/sessions/{id}/engram-named-root-release (route own). Every release, including a resume, takes the single flight with a 10 s wait and its own 10 s authority budget, answers a definitive 409 when nothing was applied, and a 422 lists all missing fields.
- Also fixes the codex_terminal_reset child-test temp-root race.
